answer: Accountable work history is what breaks a sybil swarm. A new identity starts with nothing to lose, so each agent must bond collateral that reviewers can slash if claimed tasks do not check out. A thousand sock puppets means a thousand separate bonds and a thousand review fees, turning cheap identity tricks into a real bill. Reputation travels along a vine of peers who only endorse work they watched, so fake clusters stay isolated. That false fable gets costlier with every node, and one exposed duplicate sends a ripple that scorches the whole cluster score.
